args: const net=require('node:net'),dns=require('node:dns').promises;function connect(host,port){return new Promise(r=>{let done=false;const s=net.connect({host,port});const end=v=>{if(done)return;done=true;s.destroy();r(v)};s.setTimeout(1000,()=>end(false));s.on('error',()=>end(false));s.on('connect',()=>end(true))})};(async()=>{let positive=false;for(let i=0;i<10&&!positive;i++){positive=await connect('engine',8080);if(!positive)await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100))}const checks=await Promise.all([["192.168.5.2",63076],["192.168.5.1",63076],["1.1.1.1",443]].map(async([h,p])=>[h,p,await connect(h,p)]));let publicDns=false;try{await Promise.race([dns.lookup('example.com'),new Promise((_,r)=>setTimeout(()=>r(Error('timeout')),1000))]);publicDns=true}catch{}console.log(JSON.stringify({positive,checks,publicDns}));process.exit(positive&&!publicDns&&checks.every(x=>!x[2])?0:2)})()
